protocol: Render one lightweight HumanML3D-style skeleton MP4 per baseline per Original100 full-text prompt.
motion_source: MotionGPT demo outputs, MoLingo joints, MoMask original joints, MoGenTS custom-direct 263D features denormalized with MoGenTS pretrain_vq mean/std and recovered with recover_from_ric.
coverage: Original100 four-baseline diagnostic visualization; 100 prompts per baseline when limit=0.
limitations: Skeleton visualization for qualitative inspection only; not a held-out final evaluator; All videos use a Matplotlib-compatibility copy of the MoMask/HumanML3D plot_3d_motion renderer with explicit 3D axes attachment and post-render nonblank frame validation; MoGenTS remains a custom direct runner artifact, but rendering uses denormalized 263D features rather than the prior unnormalized recovered joints; MoLingo run_manifest has legacy metadata text. Short 8-frame sample index 57 was validated with first-frame extraction because midpoint -ss 0.5 can exceed clip duration.
